description: Delete a durable user memory by its 'key' (optionally scoped to a 'kind'). Use this when the user asks you to forget something you remembered about them, or to correct an outdated preference/fact before re-adding it with remember.

key.description: The slug (key) of the memory to delete. Removes every memory with that key for the user.

kind.description: Optional: restrict deletion to this kind only. Prefer 'none' (or omit) unless the user named a kind — 'none' removes every kind sharing the key.

name: forget
